resources.string: Correct any song using the main list tag actions to provide learning feedback. Manage training and sync here. Self-selected feedback does not establish independent accuracy.

Unreviewed identities form a training-only, non-independent pilot. Development and sealed tests remain locked until the complete identity graph and lists are frozen. Paired devices automatically sync your labels.
By your usual workout playlist standard, is this whole recording suitable for your workout playlist?
Familiar with whole song and exact version
Concurrent answers below. Your next answer explicitly resolves all shown revisions.
Training currently runs on Windows using optional CPU CLAP components. This phone labels, syncs and views status; it does not run Windows model artifacts. No personal model is active.
Clear all learning corrections and results on paired devices. Old offline answers cannot return. You can start labeling again. Library, playlists, daily tags and pairing are preserved. Clear?
By your labeling standard, does this whole recording contain prominent singing or speech?
By your labeling standard, is this whole recording classical music?
By your quiet listening standard, is this whole recording suitable for calm listening? Independent of workout suitability.
Four independent dimensions: labels, training and active sync
Verify local files in this batch (up to six)
Offline or older peer; changes retained for retry
More song corrections are needed. Each dimension accumulates separately.
Review and freeze the complete identity study on Windows before computation.
Prepare the optional public components on Windows first.
Windows is checking material or running the bounded worker.
Learning stopped or was interrupted; completed analysis can resume.
Validation, material or resource requirements were not met. Read details on Windows; no head was activated.
Synthetic pipeline complete; this is not human truth or evidence of accuracy.
Frozen candidate: further independent and deployment gates are required. No personal head is active.
Corrections changed; this dimension needs learning again.
Checked %1$d candidate files; %2$d exact matches. Missing references are retained.
Learning sync requires the latest version on both devices. Your edits are saved locally.
Correct tags in the song list. Each dimension is checked separately; passing dimensions activate and update your library automatically. Manual corrections always take priority.
Learning runs on your paired Windows PC. Keep it online. This phone receives recording-matched results and supports offline corrections.
At least %3$d more corrections, including %1$d positive and %2$d negative. Continue correcting familiar songs in the list.
Active on PC; matched results update automatically
Playback has priority; learning continues when paused
Effect-check material is missing or pending; original recognition remains active
Effect check failed; original recognition remains active
Updated results apply only to the exact recording and active learning version. Songs awaiting analysis, changed files and uncovered songs use original recognition.
Unable to reach the paired PC. Keep it running and retry sync. Local corrections are saved.

The paired PC downloads a public audio model of about 615 MB plus several GB of private CPU dependencies. At least 6 GB free disk is required. Used only for local learning; songs and labels are never uploaded.
PC has not found the same recording for %1$d corrected songs. Connect its music folders and retry.
Continue correcting songs from different artists and albums.
